reply.subject: Biscuit's boarding stay is confirmed — March 24–27, 2027
reply.body:
Hi Avery,

Great news — Biscuit's boarding stay at Maple Hollow Pet Lodge is confirmed for March 24–27, 2027.

We're looking forward to having Biscuit with us. If you have any questions before the stay, just reply to this message and we'll be glad to help.

Warmly,
The Maple Hollow Pet Lodge team
